title: uea-championship
label: Agaguk

won.source: The card's own closing announcement: "in 2:57, the winner and the first ever Uniter [sic] E-Wrestling Association Champion, here is Agaguk!" (uea-uea-tournament-part-6-of-6).

how: Beat Retribution (billed representing ILOC in the tournament's own division listing, introduced from the UCW in the tag bracket) in the singles-bracket final with a powerbomb, capping a six-match night.

title: uea-tag-team-championship
label: Revelations

won.source: The card's own closing announcement: "The winners and first ever UEA Tag Team Champions, the War Machine and Zodiac, Revelations in a time of 0:17:12" (uea-uea-tournament-part-6-of-6).

how: Beat The Beasts (Neandrathal & Agaguk, LAW) in the tag-bracket final, capping the same six-match night that crowned the UEA Championship.
note: First ever UEA Tag Team Champions, billed "Revelations" from the tournament's own opening division listing (part 1 of 6: "Revelations: Zodiac & War Machine (LAW)") forward. Both entrants are billed representing LAW throughout; every entrant named in the tag bracket (Capital Punishment, Visions of Destruction, Underground Team One, The Beasts, Revelations, Knights of Avalon, The Unholy Alliance, The New Agony Inc.)
